hooks.name: Sync admin nav with permissions
hooks.description: Admin navigation (navItems) references Permission names from auth-core. When permissions or roles change, check that nav access rules and the demo session still match.

action.prompt: A permissions or roles file in packages/auth-core was saved. Compare it with `navItems` in apps/admin/src/app/permissions/navigation.ts and with packages/auth-core/src/demo/index.ts and auth-core.test.ts. Report any renamed or removed permission still referenced, or new permission that needs a nav entry. Fix only trivial mismatches in those files; otherwise list them. Remind that permissions are provisional until the backend issues its own, and that frontend checks are UX only. Do not modify other application code.
